en.topic_title: Local logistics firm’s Taiwan branch says it will not ship ‘prohibited books’ to Hong Kong – report
en.topic_summary:
The Taiwanese subsidiary of a Hong Kong logistics firm has reportedly told clients it will not ship “prohibited books” to the city to comply with the Beijing-imposed national security law.
